sloka: स्मृतिर्न ते ऽस्ति वा मन्ये व्यक्तं वा यमसादनम्।आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं यन्मां योद्धुं व्यवस्थितः ।। ६.८८.११ ।।
transliteration: smṛtirna te 'sti vā manye vyaktaṁ vā yamasādanam।āśīviṣamiva kruddhaṁ yanmāṁ yoddhuṁ vyavasthitaḥ ।। 6.88.11 ।।

translations.english: "I am like a poisonous serpent, enraged. Is it that you have lost memory, or you stood here on the way to Yama's abode, I think."
